i2v.prompt: Animate the supplied illustration as one steady 10-second 2D cartoon gym shot. Keep the same two people, their clothes and the gym. They take two or three natural steps together toward the exercise mat, exchange a short English conversation and stop beside it. The shorter person asks, "What's our warm-up?" The taller person replies, "Let's start with an easy core move. I'll show you." The shorter person says, "Okay, show me." They speak one at a time with natural mouth movement and small gestures. Keep both full bodies visible. No cuts, new people, on-screen text or music.
